evidence_detail: The register documents that historical G1-G3 line loads exist, but the numerical schedule is not present in the current canonical source inventory.
parametric_rule: w_hist,T5 = source-transcribed line load only after RC-P13 numeric rows are recovered.
model_guard: Do not reconstruct historical values from current geometry or normative loads.

evidence_detail: Member geometry and usable sections are canonical; historical material specification is documented, while an accepted current-model density is not yet registered.
parametric_rule: g_member = A_section * gamma_material; use the member's own section and an explicitly accepted density.
model_guard: Never substitute concrete strength or an unrelated reported density for unit weight.

evidence_detail: Floor structural domains exist, but slab build-up, tributary fields and unit weights are not numerically registered.
parametric_rule: g_slab = sum(t_i * gamma_i) over structurally supported documented layers.
model_guard: Do not infer slab area loads from beam sections or adjacent storeys.

evidence_detail: Finishes, screeds, partitions and their distributions lack current documentary or measured numerical coverage.
parametric_rule: g_nonstruct = sum(t_i * gamma_i); partitions remain line loads or an admitted equivalent-area rule only after explicit model approval.
model_guard: Do not silently apply a generic partition allowance.

evidence_detail: Use categories and current assessment values are not frozen by the repository evidence set.
parametric_rule: q_use = value from the explicitly adopted assessment rule after use-zone classification.
model_guard: Do not derive occupancy loads from reported apartment count alone.

evidence_detail: Raised PT geometry is documentary; inert fill, concrete pour and screeds are user-reported, with thicknesses, unit weights and structural load path unresolved.
parametric_rule: g_PT,struct = sum(g_i * A_struct,i); ground-supported portions are excluded from frame/foundation gravity loading.
model_guard: Do not apply the complete PT build-up to the frame or foundation beams by default.

evidence_detail: Terrace geometry and a-d as-built support subsystem are documented; supported terrace segmentation, layers and numerical loads are unresolved.
parametric_rule: G_G1terrace = supported layer weights + documented edge/member weights; Q assigned only after use classification.
model_guard: Keep a-d in the as-built model and do not promote reported historical omission to DOC.

evidence_detail: Architectural outlines are documentary; structural mechanism, layers, parapets, tributary binding and numerical values remain open.
parametric_rule: G_balcony = G_slab + G_finishes + G_parapet + G_edge; Q_balcony remains separately adopted.
model_guard: Do not infer balcony cantilever action or loads from ordinary beam reinforcement schedules.

evidence_detail: Three top terrace wings are documentary; interior/terrace boundaries, support paths, construction layers and load values remain open.
parametric_rule: G_topterrace = sum(t_i * gamma_i) by proven supported zone; Q only after use classification.
model_guard: Do not convert the user-qualified apartment statement into a load category.

evidence_detail: The dedicated subsystem is documented, but exact 3D member paths, footprint, tributary areas and construction layers remain open.
parametric_rule: G_stair/tower = G_flights + G_landings + G_walls + G_roof after exact binding.
model_guard: Do not flatten stair/tower loads into the ordinary floor frame.

evidence_detail: Eight host ends are DOC; the 1.50 m length is user-reported and tributary roof/wall/perimeter binding is open.
parametric_rule: G_eave = self_weight(host overhang) + evidenced tributary roof/wall/perimeter loads.
model_guard: Do not use 1.50 m as DOC or generalize the rafter detail to gronda/cornice objects.

evidence_detail: Ordinary roof frame geometry is frozen; special roof geometry, layer build-up, tributary surfaces and assessment parameters are not all numerically ready.
parametric_rule: G_roof from documented layers; variable/environmental actions only from adopted current assessment inputs and proven surfaces.
model_guard: Do not load ridge/fold lines or gronda sets as structural members without a documented role.

evidence_detail: Outward shift is user-qualified; current and historical infill lines, wall build-up and causal geometry are not directly cross-registered.
parametric_rule: G_infill = w_infill * L_confirmed; mass and eccentricity only after current/historical line registration.
model_guard: Do not create shifted line load, seismic mass or eccentricity from the narrative alone.

evidence_detail: Six comparison domains are registered; none has direct evidence sufficient for a numerical historical omission delta.
parametric_rule: Delta_effect = Effect_asbuilt(traceable current model) - Effect_historical(traceable source model).
model_guard: Never rewrite the historical model to match the as-built configuration.

evidence_detail: Gravity-load values, structural transfer, supported areas and admitted mass participation rules are not yet complete.
parametric_rule: M = admitted permanent-load masses + admitted variable-load fraction, assembled only from traceable load rows.
model_guard: Do not count ground-supported fill or unbound special geometry automatically as frame seismic mass.

evidence_detail: No current calculation combination set is frozen because numerical actions and adopted assessment rules are incomplete.
parametric_rule: Combinations are generated only after every included action has provenance and an explicit adopted assessment rule.
model_guard: Historical load cases and present assessment combinations must remain separate.
